Package com.irurueta.navigation.inertial.calibration.gyroscope

Class GyroscopeCovariancePropagationAssert

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.navigation.inertial.calibration.gyroscope.GyroscopeCovariancePropagationAssert
final class GyroscopeCovariancePropagationAssert extends Object
Checks that the general-case gyroscope calibrators propagate the fitter covariance to the published parameter covariance correctly.

The fitter unknowns are b = (bx, by, bz) (only when biases are estimated), M = Mg + I stored column-wise (m11, m21, m31, m12, m22, m32, m13, m23, m33) and G stored column-wise (only when G-dependent cross biases are estimated). The published parameters are: 

 bg = M * b                              (only when biases are estimated)
 sx, sy, sz, mxy, mxz, myx, myz, mzx, mzy = entries of M - I
 Gg = M * G                              (zero when cross biases are not estimated)
This class rebuilds that mapping independently of the calibrators, differentiates it numerically, and checks that J * Cov * J' equals the covariance published by the calibrator. A wrong or misplaced entry anywhere in a calibrator's analytical Jacobian makes the check fail.

    • assertCovariancePropagated

      static void assertCovariancePropagated(Object calibrator, com.irurueta.algebra.Matrix estimatedCovariance, boolean estimatesBias, boolean estimatesCrossBiases)
      Asserts that the covariance published by a calibrator after a general-case calibration equals the fitter covariance propagated through a numerically differentiated Jacobian.
      Parameters:
      calibrator - calibrator that has finished a general-case calibration.
      estimatedCovariance - covariance returned by the calibrator.
      estimatesBias - true when the calibrator estimates biases (bias unknowns and published bg rows are present), false for known-bias calibrators.
      estimatesCrossBiases - true when G-dependent cross biases are estimated.
